sketches.mechanism: Rust's borrow checker prevents having mutable and immutable references simultaneously — you cannot change what you are still observing
sketches.resonance: To truly see someone, you must stop trying to change them; observation and mutation cannot coexist.

sketches.mechanism: A LEFT JOIN preserves every row from the left table even when no matching row exists on the right — unmatched rows fill with NULL
sketches.resonance: You carry every absence with you; the missing reply doesn't erase the question, it fills the space with NULL.
sketches.draft:
SELECT
    every_thing_i_said.moment,
    what_you_answered.words
FROM
    every_thing_i_said
LEFT JOIN
    what_you_answered
ON
    every_thing_i_said.moment = what_you_answered.moment;

sketches.mechanism: The finally block executes regardless of whether the try succeeds or the catch fires — it runs no matter what
sketches.resonance: No matter what happens — success, failure, exception — some things you do anyway, unconditionally.
